tech_stack.frontend: Next.js 15, React 19, Tailwind CSS v4, Zustand
tech_stack.backend: Next.js API Routes, Vercel AI SDK (@ai-sdk/google, gemini-3.1-flash-lite)
tech_stack.storage: Local JSON / localStorage (for My Savings tool)

pipelines.ci_cd: GitHub Actions -> AWS SSM Run Command -> EC2 Docker Hosts
pipelines.automation: Zero-SSH deployment. Code pushed to main triggers build, pushes artifact, and SSM triggers docker-compose up.

infrastructure.security: VPC with public/private subnets, Security Groups restricting EC2 inbound to CloudFront Prefix Lists, Cognito for Auth
infrastructure.iac: Terraform used to provision VPC, Subnets, EC2, and IAM roles.
